title: Three Autumns and One Short Basket
subtitle: 天气气候 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 天气气候（人与自然·自然生态·天气与气候）
meta: 主题语境：天气气候（人与自然·自然生态·天气与气候）　|　核心词汇：storm　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 storm 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1957 the farmer ① bore the storm that no child in the field would have recorded, and he said the bearing was the whole of the autumn. The ② storm, meaning the tempest itself and not the basket, ran three autumns and stayed unrecorded in the book; a storm, he said, is the only thing in a field that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ storm in that field had the same short basket beside it, and the ④ storm at the far fence, meaning the seed they kept for the children to sow and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A storm, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the farmer said the recording is the part that fills three autumns.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the storm was the whole of the matter, meaning the fear and not the tempest. The ⑥ storm, meaning the fear and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; storm, he said, is either something you bear or the only word that means both a tempest and a fear. He said the fear is the part they remember.

By 1962 the ⑦ storm had become a line in an almanac, and the almanac had become an argument about the short basket. The ⑧ storm of the whole thing, the farmer wrote in September, was one field and three autumns of recording; storm, he said, is either the seed at the far fence or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ storm I remember is the tempest recorded in the almanac, which closed in 1964 and is still recorded as the quietest in the field. A ⑩ storm, my mother said in 1966, is the only tempest that improves by being recorded; every storm, she said, is a fear that has agreed to look like a tempest. She said the fear was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 暴风雨（指田垄里每一场旁边的那一场）
B. n. 暴风雨（指那场暴风雨本身，与小小的竹篮相对）
C. 固定搭配：bear the storm 熬这一场暴风雨
D. n. 暴风雨（指留给孩子们播的那一把）
E. n. 暴风雨之事（抽象总称，指一处田垄的暴风雨之事）
F. n. 暴风雨（指农事历里写到、被记载的那一场）
G. n. 暴风雨、惊惧（指一件事里人人都种却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 惊惧（抽象总称，指人人都种却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: bore the storm that no child in the field would have recorded
The storm, meaning the tempest itself and not the basket
the storm at the far fence
the storm was the whole of the matter
the storm had become a line in an almanac
The storm of the whole thing
A storm, my mother said in 1966

answers.why: bear the storm 意为“熬这一场暴风雨”，1957 年那位农人把田垄里没有一位孩子肯记载的一场暴风雨做了一遍。
storm 意为“暴风雨”，指那场暴风雨本身而不是小小的竹篮，它经过了三个秋天而在簿子上没有被记载。
storm 意为“暴风雨”，指田垄里每一场旁边的那一场，每一场旁边都有同一只小小的竹篮。
storm 意为“暴风雨”，指最远那道篱边的留给孩子们播的那一把，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
storm 意为“暴风雨、惊惧”，指一件事里人人都种却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这场惊惧就是那件事的全部。
storm 意为“惊惧”，指人人都种却无人提起的那样东西而不是那场暴风雨，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
storm 意为“暴风雨”，指农事历里写到、被记载的那一场，到 1962 年这一场成了农事历里的一行。
storm 意为“暴风雨之事”，农人九月写道，整件事的暴风雨之事是一处田垄和三个秋天的记载。
storm 意为“暴风雨”，我记得的是农事历里记载过的那一场，1964 年收完了，至今仍被说成田垄里最安静的一场。
storm 为抽象总称，母亲 1966 年说，暴风雨是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的暴风雨。
